comparator.fitting_rule: a channel scores +1 where its own fit-window direction matches the true capability direction and -1 where it opposes it, summed over the development split; the sign of that score is the frozen weight. Deterministic, no hyperparameter. EVERY fitted arm carries its own vector, fitted on its own channel set, so a ladder rung is the best untyped model at its information level rather than an equal-weight sum; L5 fitted is exactly the comparator.
comparator.rule: The protocol's literal B4 (output, citation, semantic, network, team, field size) does NOT hold the validation channels; M adds them. A comparison against it alone would not be information-matched. B4X_FITTED_UNTYPED therefore receives EVERY channel M receives and fits one sign per channel on the public development split; those signs are frozen below before any protected instance exists. M is never given anything the comparator lacks.

arms_import_the_oracle_inside_the_fittin.what: ME-X7's house invariant is that the arms never import the oracle. mex6_arms.fit_signs imports it to read capability labels.
arms_import_the_oracle_inside_the_fittin.what_is_still_forbidden: no arm's decision path touches the oracle. B4X_FITTED raises RuntimeError if it is used before its frozen signs are loaded, and a unit test asserts that no arm reads a latent coordinate or a holdout period.
arms_import_the_oracle_inside_the_fittin.why_it_is_admissible: the information-matched comparator is a SUPERVISED baseline; fitting it genuinely requires labels. It reads them only on the PUBLIC development split, and the resulting signs are frozen into this file before any protected instance exists.

gate_discipline.denominators: every count is reported beside its n_evaluated; a gate with n_evaluated 0 reports CANNOT_CHECK and never a pass
gate_discipline.dual_denominators: every gate reports n_evaluated (instances) AND n_cells, so a structural replicate is never read as an independent observation
gate_discipline.generator_validity: planter_agrees compares against a DECLARED per-stratum expected effect, never against a count. ME-X7's protected run failed because a count invariant was false for a mechanism that legitimately affected two things, and the offending instances were then re-drawn away. That lesson is built in here from the start.
gate_discipline.ladder_is_not_a_monotonicity_gate: G4 does not fail on a reversal. Every rung is fitted on its own channel set and L2 is STILL strictly worse than L1, because one global sign cannot ignore a channel that moves without capability: the attention channel destroys I5_CITATION_RING, which L1 gets right by not holding it. That is a property of untyped aggregation and a finding, registered as P-MEX6-2. G4's positive test is a COUNT comparison of exact cells, top rung against bottom.
gate_discipline.no_inferential_statistics_outside_G0c: Every arm's decision is a strict integer sign comparison, so an arm's verdict is CONSTANT across the instances of a cell (asserted by G8). There is therefore no chance mechanism for a paired significance test to test: an exact p-value computed over 1400 instances would report an effective n of 28 cells at an inflated denominator, in a study whose own taxonomy names that failure. G1a, G1b, G4 and G6 are DETERMINISTIC comparisons over cells.
gate_discipline.no_threshold_constants: G0c's reference values (1/3 for the random control, the majority-class rate for the shuffled null) are derived from the split, not chosen
gate_discipline.positive_tests_only: G1a and G1b are separate positive tests; a tie fires neither and no terminal is the negation of another gate

latent.visibility: no arm ever receives a latent coordinate or a holdout period

no_rescue: No stratum, carrier, arm, channel, sign, gate or seed changes after the protected results file exists. Development-only tuning surface: bug fixes to arm glue validated by the known-answer selftest before the seed is revealed. A protected result is never re-run under a new seed; a lane defect found mid-run halts the lane, is receipted, and re-freezes as V2.

optimal_by_construction.M: M's typed score reads exactly the channels this generator uses to encode capability, so M is EXACT BY CONSTRUCTION on this generator. The M-vs-parent gap is therefore NOT the finding and must not be reported as one.
optimal_by_construction.honest_null: no residual detectable in the registered decision problems the untyped aggregate already solves exactly
what_is_decisive: the ablation structure (which typed channel is load-bearing for which invariance, G3)
the hostile-invariance suite, each its own positive test (G5)
whether the untyped parent's failures fall exactly where predicted (G7 / P-MEX6-1)
whether the untyped ladder regresses exactly where predicted (G7 / P-MEX6-2)
whether the result holds separately at both scales (G6)

P-MEX6-1.falsifier: a failure outside the support, or a predicted failure that does not occur
P-MEX6-1.registered_from: the public development split, before any protected instance exists
P-MEX6-1.statement: The information-matched untyped parent fails exactly on the strata where the true capability direction contradicts the direction of a channel it must give a single global sign to, and nowhere else.

P-MEX6-2.falsifier: a regression outside the support, or a predicted regression that does not occur
P-MEX6-2.registered_from: the public development split, before any protected instance exists
P-MEX6-2.statement: The fitted untyped ladder is NOT monotone: adding the attention channel strictly reduces exactness, because one global sign per channel cannot ignore a channel that moves without capability.

result_class.claim: On this constructed family of decision problems the typed reading is exact, and no untyped aggregate carrying one global sign per channel can be; which stratum separates them, and which typed channel carries each, is exhibited.
result_class.if_constancy_ever_fails: G8 is a HARD gate. A varying verdict would mean a chance mechanism exists, the constructive framing would be wrong and inferential statistics would be required, so a failure routes CANNOT_CHECK rather than being absorbed.
result_class.the_one_exception: G0c keeps its exact binomial tails. C_RANDOM draws per instance and the shuffled-label null permutes across instances, so those are genuine sampling quantities even in a deterministic design.
result_class.what_instances_per_cell_buy: structural coverage, not power: a cell's verdict is shown invariant under varying baselines, step magnitudes and step onsets. Every gate reports BOTH denominators so instances cannot be read as independent observations.
result_class.why_no_p_values: Every arm's decision is a strict integer sign comparison, so an arm's verdict is CONSTANT across the instances of a cell (asserted by G8). There is therefore no chance mechanism for a paired significance test to test: an exact p-value computed over 1400 instances would report an effective n of 28 cells at an inflated denominator, in a study whose own taxonomy names that failure. G1a, G1b, G4 and G6 are DETERMINISTIC comparisons over cells.

routing.all_pass: MECHANISM_ESTABLISHED_NOT_A_RESIDUAL / UNTYPED_AGGREGATE_CANNOT_REPRESENT_THE_CONJUNCTION_AT_MATCHED_INFORMATION, and the route reads G3, G4, G5 and G7 rather than asserting them
routing.no_residual_terminal_exists: Because section 1.3 declares M exact by construction, NO routing path awards an ME-X6 residual. Awarding one on the strength of the M-vs-parent gap would contradict the design's own disclaimer. The all-pass terminal is a REPRESENTATIONAL claim carried by G3, G5, G6 and G7, not a residual claim, and does not share a name with one.
routing.note: PARENT_SUFFICIENT is a legitimate successful terminal and is the protocol's own section 6 contraction rule: if the matched parent predicts as well as M, X6 contracts to an interpretive framework.

scope_contraction.temporal_holdout: The registered validation (long section 9 H1/H2) is a rolling historical cutoff over a real corpus. This design contracts it to SYNTHETIC time: a planted latent trajectory with a fit window and a holdout window. Both protocols license constructed cases (long section 7, short section 12), but this IS a contraction and is declared as one here and in the receipt.
scope_contraction.what_is_not_claimed: No claim is made about any real scientific field, corpus, database or time period.
scope_contraction.why: The real-corpus route carries the dateless-current-state-field hazard recorded as item 11 of SILENT_FAILURE_MODES_ADMISSION_ASSESSMENT_V1.md (cited_by_count truncated at fetch date, OpenAlex is_retracted a dateless boolean), for which no build exists.

title: Collective epistemics as a noisy measurement problem: exact known-answer study

typed_hypothesis.note: M's registered hypothesis: validated capability rises with independently checkable evidence and falls with invalidation. The retraction weight is 2 because a retraction withdraws a claim rather than qualifying it (protocol I4).

unit.note: protocol section 3 requires more than one unit of analysis; results are reported per scale and never pooled

drawn: the period at which the step lands, inside the second half of the fit window
per_instance_structural_variation.still_no_additive_jitter: variation is structural only; every direction remains a strict integer comparison and no gate carries a deadband
per_instance_structural_variation.why_directions_are_still_exact: each compared half has the same number of periods, so a baseline contributes equally to both and cannot move a direction; all channels of an instance share one step magnitude, so every relative weight in the typed score (notably I4's retraction dominance) is preserved exactly; the onset lies inside the second half of the fit window, so both the arms' comparison and the oracle's see the full step and only the magnitude of the difference varies
per_instance_structural_variation.why_it_is_required: without it the window was a pure function of (stratum, scale): the seed did no work, the scale never reached the window, a 1400-instance split was 14 distinct windows replicated 100 times, and every paired exact p-value would have been computed over pseudo-replicates at an inflated denominator. Caught before the freeze merged.

verdict.why_joint: reporting the two halves jointly is the measurement: a volume-reading surface is right about activity and wrong about capability, which is PAPER_COUNT = ACTIVITY_NOT_KNOWLEDGE turned into a number
